# Texas Capital Securities Advises RRC Companies


Published on Jun 29, 2026


Texas Capital Securities (“TCS”) is pleased to announce that RRC Companies (“RRC,” or the “Company”), a leading provider of full-scope engineering services to the power & energy sector, has received a majority growth investment from New Mountain Capital (“NMC”), a leading growth-oriented investment firm. RRC’s management team and employees will retain a meaningful ownership stake in the Company. The partnership positions RRC to accelerate its growth and scale a differentiated, full-lifecycle engineering platform at the center of the energy transition.
